title: Hotel California (chorus)
hook: Why Hotel California's chorus *won't let you out*
cover_text: Part 2: the chorus that *locks the door*
question: Verse or chorus: which part traps you more? 👇

chords.name: G
chords.text: It opens on *G major*. Warm, bright: a welcome.

chords.name: D
chords.text: *D major*, the relative major. Daylight at last.

chords.name: F#
chords.text: Then *A♯* creeps in. F♯ major: the trap springs.

chords.name: Bm
chords.text: *A♯ rises to B*. B minor: the door clicks shut.

chords.name: Em
chords.text: *E minor* dims it. The light starts fading.

chords.name: F#
chords.text: *F♯* again. A♯ pulls you back toward B…
